primary_goal: Prompt visitors to enter their delivery address and submit the search form to view available restaurants and shops nearby.

friction_points.issue: Primary CTA button ('Suchen') lacks strong visual hierarchy and high-contrast styling against the orange background.
friction_points.evidence: The search button in slice 1 is styled in dark grey ('Suchen') inside the white address bar, making it look secondary rather than a prominent primary action on an orange background.

friction_points.issue: Missing visible payment logos (PayPal, Klarna, Apple Pay, Cash) near the top search area or in trust badges.
friction_points.evidence: Payment methods are only mentioned as plain body text ('Bezahle online oder in bar') deep in slice 3, with zero payment provider badges near the hero section.

friction_points.issue: Lack of visual food category shortcuts (e.g. Pizza, Sushi, Burger) to trigger impulse food ordering.
friction_points.evidence: In slices 1 and 2, there are no clickable cuisine icons or quick-filters below the address field, relying entirely on users typing an address first.

friction_points.issue: No explicit 'Standort verwenden' (Use my current location) quick-action button visibly highlighted in the address input.
friction_points.evidence: The input field in slice 1 displays 'M7 13, 68161 Mannheim' with a clear (x) icon, but lacks a visible location-pin button to auto-detect position instantly.

friction_points.issue: Copyright year display error in footer ('© 2026 Lieferando.de').
friction_points.evidence: The footer bottom line in slice 4 displays '© 2026 Lieferando.de', showing a future year date issue.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we add a explicit 'Standort verwenden' (Use current location) button inside/next to the search input, then search conversion rate will increase because address input friction is reduced for mobile and desktop users.
hypotheses.change: Add a visual target/location icon button labeled 'Standort verwenden' inside the search input bar.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we add recognizable payment icons (PayPal, Klarna, Apple Pay, EC) right below the address search field, then initial search submissions will increase because German consumers gain immediate trust regarding payment flexibility.
hypotheses.change: Display payment logos directly under the main address input bar in the hero container.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we introduce visual cuisine shortcuts (Pizza, Burger, Sushi, Döner) below the search input, then user engagement will increase because visual food triggers appetite and lowers decision inertia.
hypotheses.change: Add clickable food icon pills below the search box that populate popular categories upon entering an address.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we replace plain text benefit bullet points with visual payment badges and TÜV/rating seals in the guarantee section, then user trust will increase because visual proof is scanned faster than text.
hypotheses.change: Replace checkmark text in 'Deine Vorteile' with graphical badges and payment icons.

quick_wins: Fix the footer copyright year text from '© 2026 Lieferando.de' to the current year.
Increase the contrast and visual weight of the 'Suchen' button in the hero search bar.
Add payment provider brand logos (PayPal, Klarna) to the 'Bezahle online oder in bar' section in slice 3.
uncertainties: Whether automatic browser geolocation is prompted immediately on page load.
How address auto-completion performs when users begin typing in the search bar.
What proportion of website visitors are returning logged-in users vs. first-time visitors.
